issues.description: getSourceMap does synchronous readFileSync per stack frame with no caching
issues.detail: For each external-module frame, the code calls existsSync + readFileSync + parse. A stack with N frames in the same file pays N reads and N parses of a stable value, blocking the event loop during error reporting. Memoize by file path with a Map<file, SourceMap|null>.

issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) silently changes path semantics without documenting the contract on `from`
issues.detail: The fix assumes `from` is always a file path so `..` strips the filename, but breaks for empty strings, directories, or URLs. Prefer path.resolve(path.dirname(from), s) to name the intent, and document the precondition on `from`. The change is probably correct but easy to regress.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' as a sentinel for missing map files, masking failures
issues.detail: Returning the literal string '{}' conflates 'file missing' with 'empty map' and produces a valid-but-empty SourceMap downstream. This is a leaky abstraction tied to a convert-source-map quirk. Return undefined and let the caller decide, or throw — don't swallow the signal silently.

issues.description: Source-map helpers belong in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts, not test-run.ts
issues.detail: extractSourcemapFromFile and createConvertSourceMapReadMap are stateless source-map transforms unrelated to TestRun lifecycle. They should live next to DecodedMap in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts so the module boundary matches responsibility, and TestRun depends only on the abstraction.

issues.description: New convert-source-map dependency duplicates capability already present in the jridgewell toolchain
issues.detail: The repo already depends on @jridgewell/trace-mapping and ships its own DecodedMap. Adding convert-source-map (plus @types) for finding a sourceMappingURL comment and reading the referenced file is roughly 30 lines of regex + fs. Justify the dep in the PR or drop it for an in-tree filter.

issues.description: External-module predicate complects 'is external' with 'has no transformResult' and 'exists on disk'
issues.detail: `!mod?.transformResult && existsSync(file)` intertwines module identity, Vite transform state, and filesystem existence. When Vite's internals shift what transformResult holds, this silently degrades. Extract an isExternalUntransformed(file) predicate and state the assumption explicitly.

synthesis.summary: The fix is directionally correct — external-module stack frames now resolve to original sources — but the implementation complects several concerns and leaves contracts unstated. The panel agrees on three P1 issues: synchronous per-frame file I/O with no caching, an undocumented semantic shift in resolve(from, '..', s), and a leaky '{}' sentinel masking missing map files. Two P2 placement/dependency concerns round out the consensus: the helpers belong in packages/utils/src/source-map.ts, and the new convert-source-map dep duplicates capability already in the jridgewell toolchain. None block, but caching, contract documentation, and helper relocation are required before merge feels clean.
